# shared_runfiles_support

B69 of docs/OSS_CORPUS.md: a tool analyzed in two exec configurations
whose output directories are equal. `on_a` runs on the host platform
`//plat:host` (it needs constraint `//plat:a`), `on_b` on `//plat2:host`
(the first registered execution platform); both `host` platforms name their
output directory `k8` (the legacy platform-name heuristic), so `//:t` is
analyzed twice into `bazel-out/k8-opt-exec`, the configurations differing in
`--platforms` only. Bazel shares the equal actions of the two configured
targets, its RunfilesSupport actions included (Actions.canBeShared on
RepoMappingManifestAction, SourceManifestAction, SymlinkTreeAction): genuine
9.3.1 (`--batch --ignore_all_rc_files build
--host_platform=//plat:host --extra_execution_platforms=//plat2:host
//:on_a //:on_b`) builds both, `cquery` lists `//:t` twice with the
executable `bazel-out/k8-opt-exec/bin/t_/t`, and
`bazel-out/k8-opt-exec/bin/t_/t.repo_mapping` is `,x,_main\n`. bazel-rs
0.5.0 failed with `file 't_/t.repo_mapping' is generated by these
conflicting actions` (the runfiles support actions were never shared).
Pinned by tests/runfiles_trees.rs `equal_runfiles_support_actions_are_shared`.
